content.thinking: I've noted several data quirks: fixed-width code columns, an ambiguous NULL in CLOSE_DT, no void-status invoices despite the dictionary listing one, journal counts matching invoices plus payments exactly, and SRC_REF's PAY- prefix apparently marking AP journals rather than user names. I'll investigate each of these next.

input.sql: SELECT 'closedt_type' k, pg_typeof("CLOSE_DT")::text a, count(*)::text b FROM "GLPERD" GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'srcref_pattern', "SRC_CD"||' '||CASE WHEN "SRC_REF" LIKE 'PAY-%' THEN 'PAY-' WHEN "SRC_REF" LIKE 'INV-%' THEN 'INV-' ELSE "SRC_REF" END, count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY "SRC_CD", 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_jrnl', "SRC_CD", count("REF_JRNL_NO")::text FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY "SRC_CD" UNION ALL SELECT 'unbalanced_journals', 'n', count(*)::text FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_both_or_neither', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE ("DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0) OR ("DR_AMT" IS NULL AND "CR_AMT" IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_lines', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'null_dr', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT" IS NULL OR "CR_AMT" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_lines', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_no_lines', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_bad_prd', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_date_outside_prd', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_jrnl_dangling', 'n', count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" x WHERE x."JRNL_NO"=h."REF_JRNL_NO")

SELECT h.*, (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT min("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY "SRC_CD", ("REF_JRNL_NO" IS NULL)) OR h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 25
